title: Zephyrine and the Kitchen
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
